ctx.x: And he says, because he was very secretive and he would sit and play that stuff that he---- harmony, big enough harmony, polyharmony but you didn't realize what it is, because he was playing music. You see, when music becomes complete, you don't realize what he's doing in there, because he's doing here, takes all of these surprises out of it. He may playing dissonance up here, but down here, he's got something to take all that surprise out. This is what you hear. You listen to these great pianistsand they be…
For example, Art Tatum was playing all that stuff but it doesn't sound like he's playing, he don't put no tag to what he's doing so this is what I'm saying.
Now, this guy, Gershwin was a student of his.
